report.answer: A white mid-size SUV drives left-to-right across the intersection at essentially steady speed - Newton's 1st law: engine thrust balances rolling resistance + air drag so net force ~0. Over frames 120-199 when fully visible side-on it holds a straight, level path with speed ~4.8 m/s (~11 mph), typical for a careful intersection crossing.
assumptions: SUV motion in vertical plane roughly facing camera / side-on, depth ~constant
scale from SUV overall length 4.82 +/-0.30 m side-on

forks.label: Same drive on the Moon
forks.why: Horizontal cruise speed should be unchanged; weight for traction is 1/6 but rolling resistance is tiny at this speed.

forks.label: Remove air
forks.why: At ~5 m/s drag is << rolling resistance, so speed trace would look identical - proves drag is negligible here.
